name: NärCon Sommar
blurb: Northern Europe's biggest cosplay and gaming festival, an alcohol- and drug-free gathering at Linköping University.

editions.evidence: Homepage countdown text: 'NärCon Sommar 2027 July 22–25 Linköping University Get your ticket later here'

notes: No guest list is published yet for the 2027 edition. The homepage has no 'guests' link; a direct /guests URL 404s back to the homepage, and the only guest-adjacent links found are the Nordic Cosplay Championship and 'about/rules' cosplay-competition pages, not a celebrity guest roster. WebSearch found only generic 'meet famous guests' marketing copy, no actual 2027 names, so guests is marked none-yet rather than guessing. NärCon also runs a separate Vinter (winter) edition in Jönköping (www.narcon.se/vinter-cosplay) — out of scope for this id, which covers Sommar only, per RESEARCH.md's rule to keep two-show-a-year brands together only when they share one brand/city; NärCon Vinter is a different city so would need its own id if added later.
